$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for NEPALI (ne-NP): एलर्जी, असहिष्णु, सेलियाक, ग्लुटेन फ्री / मुक्त, <allergen> नभएको/नभएका, बिना <allergen> / <allergen> बिनाको, नहाल्नुहोस् / नराख्नुहोस्, खान मिल्दैन / हुँदैन / सक्दिन, पच्दैन, सहँदैन, सुरक्षित, लागि उपयुक्त, मिसिएको / अंश हुन सक्छ — plus romanised Nepali (allergy cha, khana mildaina, dudh nabhayeko). Vowel signs, virama and chandrabindu are stripped on both sides, so every stem is checked by its skeleton: bare नभएको (आज खुला नभएको?) and bare बिना are NOT stems. OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
